target: BVBRC-85 / Ali et al. 2019 / MRSA SO-1977

gene_calling.notes: Paper reported 2629 (RAST); NCBI PGAP re-annotation is 2783. All three callers within expected pipeline variance for a 2.83 Mb genome.

amr_key_genes.protocol: abricate 1.4.0 vs CARD/NCBI/ResFinder (dbs refreshed 2026-Jul-03), same defaults for all 3 strains

mecR1.note: abricate default cov cutoff drops it; independent tblastn against MRSA252 MecR1 confirms real edge-truncated gene

blaZ.note: SO1977 blaZ detected in ResFinder(99.66%) and NCBI(blaPC1 99.41%), not in CARD default; MRSA252 blaZ hit only present in NCBI DB not CARD

norA.verdict: CONTRADICTED — norA present in all 3 at similar ID; agrees with prior replication's contradiction finding

mlst.protocol: manual pubMLST scheme allele blastn (100% ID + 100% coverage) + saureus.txt profile lookup
mlst.note: Paper does not report an ST; this independent MLST call matches prior replication finding of ST140.

comparison_summary.notes: Contradiction (norA) is a confirmation of the prior replication's already-documented contradiction of the original paper — not a mismatch with prior replication.
